subject: Segmented replatform schedule, integration checkpoints & fallback matrix
messages:
From: Tom Murray <tmurray@acme-corp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Replatform sequencing — can you provide a segmented timeline + rollback options?

Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our infra team needs a pragmatic sequence for the replatform — we want to migrate our inference traffic off a legacy internal service into Redwood across 3 business units over a 6 week window.

Key asks:
- A week-by-week sequencing (per BU) with integration checkpoints.
- Clear safety/fallback gates if latency or error rate regresses.
- Any procurement or compliance prerequisites that will block start of staging.

Can you send a compact schedule and a fallback matrix we can review with SRE and procurement?

Appreciate it — Tom
Tom Murray
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Financial Services

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Tom Murray <tmurray@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Replatform sequencing — can you provide a segmented timeline + rollback options?

Tom — thanks, this is totally doable. Attached is a first-pass "segmented schedule" and an accompanying "fallback matrix". High-level summary below: 

Week 0 (prep): contract signature, KMS key exchange, network peering validation, access provisioning for two staging projects. 
Week 1–2 (BU A): non-prod traffic cutover to Redwood-staging, telemetry validation, KV/prefix cache warm-up. Canary traffic (5% of requests) for 48–72 hrs. 
Week 3 (BU B): repeat pattern with expanded autograph tests; if SLA >= 99.9% and 95th latency delta <= 20ms vs baseline, advance. 
Week 4 (BU C): parallel canary + dark-launch verification for new endpoints. 
Week 5 (Ramp): 25% → 60% traffic step-ups across BUs with rollback windows nightly. 
Week 6 (Go-live): final cutover and post-migration retention review.

Fallback gates (excerpt):
- Green: error rate delta <= +0.1% and 95th latency delta <= +20ms — proceed.
- Amber: error rate delta between +0.1%–+0.5% or latency increase +20–+50ms — pause and triage; require runbook step sign-off from Acme SRE and Redwood on-call.
- Red: error rate delta > +0.5% or production failures — immediate rollback to previous routing, open P1.

Attachments: segmented-schedule-v1.xlsx (detailed timeline), fallback-matrix.csv (gates and automated actions), integration-checklist.pdf (network/KMS/procurement items).

Next steps I propose: 1) Quick alignment call with Acme SRE (30m) Thursday; 2) Procurement confirms PO timeline so we can book reserved capacity.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Murray <tmurray@acme-corp.com>, ops@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-06T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Replatform sequencing — technical notes on canary and cache warm-up

Looping in a couple of low-level items I want on the checklist so the canary behaves like production: 
- KV cache seeding: if you have stable prefixes we can pre-populate KV cache for the top 10k customer prefixes — reduces cold-starts in week 1 canary. We'll need a dump of prefix sample (format in integration-checklist.pdf).
- Tokenization parity: confirm model tokenizer versions; we recommend pinning the model hash for staging to match production tokenization artifacts.
- Batching schedule: to keep latency tight during 25% ramp we suggest a max-batch-wait of 8ms and a CPU spill threshold set per-GPU (details in notes).

Also: automated rollback via smart routing — we can configure route policies to return to the legacy endpoint automatically on Red gate triggers (we'll need an API endpoint for the fallback target).

I attached a short runbook snippet in the integration doc.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: procurement@acme-corp.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Murray <tmurray@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Segmented replatform schedule, integration checkpoints & fallback matrix — PO and compliance checklist

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the schedule. A couple of procurement/compliance clarifications before we can issue a PO: 
- Can Redwood provide SOC2 Type II report and the last 12 months of SL uptime for the hosted API?
- Data residency: we need confirmation that logs retained during canaries will be stored in us-east-1 and not replicated outside region.
- Pricing: confirm reserved capacity lead time and ability to pause reserved capacity during non-production phases.

Please provide the documents or links; if these are ready we can fast-track the PO and an initial 30-day reserved commit.

Regards,
Acme Procurement

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: procurement@acme-corp.com, Tom Murray <tmurray@acme-corp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-08T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Segmented replatform schedule, integration checkpoints & fallback matrix — PO and compliance checklist

Hi — quick update:
- SOC 2 Type II: link to report (Drive) is shared in related_links; we'll also provide a signed NDA copy if needed.
- Data residency: confirmed — staging logs can be pinned to us-east-1 for the duration of the project; we'll document retention window in the integration checklist.
- Reserved capacity: procurement can request a 30-day reserved commit; pause/unpause options are supported but require 7 business days notice. Pricing addendum attached to the Drive folder.

Action items:
1) Tom — can you nudge SRE for the prefix sample dump by EOD Monday so Rishi can seed KV cache?
2) Procurement — if you can confirm the PO window we will provision capacity and lock the staging projects.
3) I'll schedule the 30m SRE alignment call for Thursday 10/10 at 10:00 PT unless you prefer another time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a staging run.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: segmented-schedule-v1.xlsx (v1), fallback-matrix.csv, integration-checklist.pdf
